subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should this PR be rebased and narrowed back to the intended pairing-only fix before merge, or should maintainers intentionally review the broad workflow/dependency/app drift as part of this PR?
rationale: The intended pairing repair is concrete, but the live branch is conflicting and includes security/automation-sensitive files outside the stated scope; automation should not guess whether that drift is intentional.

options.title: Rebase and narrow before merge
options.body: Refresh the branch onto current main, keep only the pairing reader/store/test changes, and fix the strict JSON parse path before a fresh review.

options.title: Intentionally review the broad diff
options.body: Treat the workflow, lockfile, app, docs, extension, and localization changes as part of this PR and get the relevant owner/security review before merge.

options.title: Pause until replaced
options.body: Leave this PR open as context while a narrower maintained replacement branch carries the same pairing fix with clean ancestry.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto current main, keep only the pairing reader/store/test changes, and fix the strict JSON parse path before a fresh review.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and his history is closest to the shared allowFrom reader and current branch maintenance.
